outcome: survival with normal neurodevelopment at 2 years
cohort: The study included women with preterm breech first twins (<=33+0 weeks) born after preterm labour.
finding: Planned mode of delivery did not significantly influence survival in preterm breech-first twins, but a trend toward poorer neurodevelopment at 2 years was observed after planned vaginal delivery, whereas maternal morbidity was higher after planned caesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Planned vaginal delivery showed a trend towards poorer neurodevelopment at 2 years compared to planned caesarean delivery, while maternal morbidity was higher after planned caesarean delivery.
